description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different models across four metrics: EGP, TR-N, TR-S, and CCP. The horizontal axis represents the metrics, listed in the order EGP, TR-N, TR-S, and CCP, while the vertical axis is labeled "Performance" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, marked at intervals of 0.2. The chart features grouped bars, with each group corresponding to a metric and containing three bars representing different models: Greedy (CodeLlama-34B) in green, RPG (CodeLlama-7B) in orange, and RPG (CodeLlama-34B) in brown. For EGP, the bars have approximate values of 0.0 for RPG (CodeLlama-7B), 0.6 for Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), and 0.98 for RPG (CodeLlama-34B); for TR-N, the values are approximately 0.7 for RPG (CodeLlama-7B), 0.62 for Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), and 0.4 for RPG (CodeLlama-34B); for TR-S, the values are around 0.7 for RPG (CodeLlama-7B), 0.45 for Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), and 0.3 for RPG (CodeLlama-34B); and for CCP, the values are approximately 0.4 for RPG (CodeLlama-7B), 0.72 for Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), and 0.93 for RPG (CodeLlama-34B). The bars are not sorted in a specific order within each group, and no bars are visually emphasized.
